Rhys Elliott / Alinea :

 Analysis: GTA VI has sold 44.9M copies, not including unsold retail inventory, with the PS5 accounting for 33.7M units, and generated $4B+ in gross revenue   —  We dive into our sell-through estimates (no unsold retail copies) for the biggest game of the year, and the biggest entertainment launch of all time.

prioritas.lead_hu: A GTA VI az eddigi adatok alapján több mint 44,9 millió példányban kelt el, és több mint 4 milliárd dolláros bevételt generált.
